name: 60503 · Aurora, IL
findings: ZIP 60503 (Aurora) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60503 (Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60503 (Aurora) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
